title: What CRR says

data.source: A toy path, s(u) = u + 0.7 sin(3u), and the rotor of MATHEMATICS.md section IV. No data from the world.

prediction: On a toy clock the six lines hold as arithmetic: S = 2B/sigma, the count and the cuts do not change with speed, the seed is an exponential average, and Q T is never below (a + 2B)^2.
baseline: Ordinary calculus: path length minus chord, a change of variable, a geometric series and the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality.
why: Every line checked here is an identity or follows from the definitions, so none could have failed. This book explains the grammar. It is not evidence for it.
